text_block_list.text:
Following a strong showing in the Japan
Cup,
Симболи Рудольф intends to ride her
momentum to
the Arima Kinen, where
Марузенски will also be
competing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The news sees Rudolf, who has always
been
curious about Марузенски, set
alight with a quiet
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the next generation well on their
way to
following in her footsteps,
Симболи Рудольф seems
to have less
weighing her down than before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And following Эйр Грув and her other
friends'
requests to race as her true self,
she resolves to
run the Arima Kinen not
as the Emperor, but
simply as Symboli
Rudolf.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
